title: BUILT CoLAB Board of Directors for 2024/2027 has taken office
excerpt: On 24 January 2025, the members elected to the various boards of BUILT CoLAB – Collaborative Laboratory for the Future Built Environment, for the four-year term 2024-2027, took office. This Installation is the result of the election held on 27 December 2024. Pode consultar aqui a constituição dos novos Órgãos Sociais.
content:
On 24 January 2025, the members elected to the various boards of BUILT CoLAB – Collaborative Laboratory for the Future Built Environment, for the four-year term 2024-2027, took office. This Installation is the result of the election held on 27 December 2024.

Pode consultar aqui a constituição dos novos Órgãos Sociais.
